<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EnrollmentConfirmation" name="Enrollment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University Enrollment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Enrollment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Student" name="Applicant / Student">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Application</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideMissingDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_EnrollmentConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ObtainStudentIdCard</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_StudyPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SemesterMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AttendClasses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddDropCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GrievanceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Appeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GrievanceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ContinueSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Graduated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Withdrawn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Admissions" name="Admissions Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocsComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMissingDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConcurrentSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConcurrentJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EnrollmentEvent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ConfirmationDeadline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConfirmSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConfirmJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternationalSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternationalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Committee" name="Admissions Committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcceptedDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessFees</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetupAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InternationalOffice" name="International Student Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VisaProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_University" name="University Administration">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Start, application and document review -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Application" name="Application process started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit online application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsMerge" name="Documents checked again"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsComplete" name="All documents received?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" name="Notify applicant of missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" name="Provide missing documents"/>

    <!-- Concurrent evaluation and fee processing -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConcurrentSplit" name="Start concurrent processing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConcurrentJoin" name="Evaluation and fees completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptedDecision" name="Application accepted?"/>

    <!-- Acceptance or rejection -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection letter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Application rejected"/>

    <!-- Enrollment confirmation deadline -->
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_EnrollmentEvent" name="Enrollment confirmed before deadline?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EnrollmentConfirmed" name="Enrollment confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_EnrollmentConfirmed" messageRef="Message_EnrollmentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ConfirmationDeadline" name="Confirmation deadline reached">
      <bpmn:documentation>Deadline value is not specified in the description.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_ConfirmationDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Canceled" name="Application canceled"/>

    <!-- Post-confirmation parallel work -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConfirmSplit" name="Start enrollment setup"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOrientation" name="Send orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetupAccounts" name="Set up email, online portal and library accounts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConfirmJoin" name="Enrollment setup completed"/>

    <!-- International student branch -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalSplit" name="International student?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalMerge" name="Visa step completed or not required"/>

    <!-- Study plan and semester cycle -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainStudentIdCard" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StudyPlan" name="Create study plan">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StudyPlan" name="Study plan started"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with academic advisor"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StudyPlan" name="Study plan created"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP1" sourceRef="StartEvent_StudyPlan" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP2" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP3" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveConflicts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP4" sourceRef="Task_ResolveConflicts" targetRef="EndEvent_StudyPlan"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SemesterMerge" name="Start of semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttendClasses" name="Attend classes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses within add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades at end of semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>

    <!-- Grievance appeal -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceSplit" name="Grievance to file?"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Appeal" name="File and process appeal">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Appeal" name="Appeal started"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitAppealForm" name="Submit appeal form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitDecision" name="Await decision"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Appeal" name="Appeal decided"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Appeal" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP3" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Task_AwaitDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP4" sourceRef="Task_AwaitDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Appeal"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceMerge" name="Grievance handling finished"/>

    <!-- Continuation or exit -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContinueSplit" name="Continue, graduate or withdraw?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Graduated" name="Student graduated"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Withdrawn" name="Student withdrawn"/>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Application" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_DocsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsComplete" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsComplete == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="All documents received" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsComplete" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsComplete == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessFees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFees" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptedDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptedDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${accepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Not accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptedDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${accepted == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_EnrollmentEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_EnrollmentEvent" targetRef="Event_EnrollmentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_EnrollmentEvent" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Event_ConfirmationDeadline" targetRef="EndEvent_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Event_EnrollmentConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmSplit" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmSplit" targetRef="Task_SetupAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_SetupAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalSplit" targetRef="Task_VisaProcessing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalStudent == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" name="Not international" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalStudent == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_VisaProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge" targetRef="Task_ObtainStudentIdCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_ObtainStudentIdCard" targetRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan" targetRef="Gateway_SemesterMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Gateway_SemesterMerge" targetRef="Task_AttendClasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Task_AttendClasses" targetRef="Task_AddDropCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="Task_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="Task_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" name="Grievance filed" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_Appeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" name="No grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="SubProcess_Appeal" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ContinueSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_42" name="Continues to next semester" sourceRef="Gateway_ContinueSplit" targetRef="Gateway_SemesterMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${studentStatus == 'continuing'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_43" name="Graduates" sourceRef="Gateway_ContinueSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_Graduated">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${studentStatus == 'graduated'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_44" name="Withdraws" sourceRef="Gateway_ContinueSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_Withdrawn">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${studentStatus == 'withdrawn'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
